title: TileMapLayer, animation category folds on spinbox click
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.7.beta1.official [1c8cc9e7e]
Not reproducible in: v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta1 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

The Animation category folds when a spinbox is clicked, in a TileMapLayer's TileSet panel.

Update:
The category also folds when:
- typing a spinbox value and pressing enter
- clicking on the Add Element button in the Animation > Frames category

Reproducible in: v4.7.beta1.official [1c8cc9e7e]

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e0e1a8df-50c0-4d9b-93cd-1b3b06adeb1d

Not reproducible in: v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2fc9a261-412c-4427-baec-b28944a54bc2

### Steps to reproduce

- open the project: [animation-category-folds-on-spinbox-click.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27313945/animation-category-folds-on-spinbox-click.zip)
- in the scene panel, click on: TileMapLayer
- in the bottom TileSet panel's middle column, select the tab: Select
- in the right column, click on the top left corner tile
- resize the bottom panel to show all properties in the middle column, either by dragging up on the divider between the viewport and the bottom TileSet panel, or click the bottom right button: expand bottom panel
- in the bottom panels middle column, in the select tab, unfold the category: Animation
- to the right of the property: Columns
- click on the spinbox's up arrow

Issue:
The Animation category folds, and it has to be unfolded after every spinbox click.
Unfolding the category, shows that the value did change as expected.

All of the categories in the select column:
- Animation
- Rendering
- Terrains
- Miscellaneous

Fold, when a spinbox is clicked in or above the Animation category.

But none of the categories fold when the spinboxes are clicked in the Rendering or Terrains categories.

Expected:
Only toggle the category fold state manually.
This happens in 4.6.2.stable.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[animation-category-folds-on-spinbox-click.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27313945/animation-category-folds-on-spinbox-click.zip)
